violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

(Various food product) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
Inspector observed several packaged cans of RAID(roach spray). PIC informed to remove establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (all refrigeration units ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The floors in kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (bags of cheese cubes) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (vegetable peeler and pans) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

(Chicken) was observed held at (120) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

(Various food product) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The cutting boards in the (kitchen) are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces of the have an accumulation of debris: -equipment shelves -stove hoods -equipment -prep table -all refrigeration/cold hold units -bakers rack New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The floors and walls throughout the kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
The (ceilings ) in the (kitchen and bathroom ) area is in poor repair. Observed missing tiles The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/14/2026
